key_event: Destroys the imperial throne-stone publicly at the new-moon ceremony; dies in the buried-temple chamber collapse alongside Bhoomi-Takshaka. Both Bloodline-A heirs fall under the same rubble.
new_relationships: Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata inherits the elephant-bond; Hampi-of-the-Bronze becomes his ward; Veerappa-Hadali holds the Council veto she promised
notes: Hero death is the spine event of the entire male-led restructure. Her Stage III mark passes to her cousin unworn; he begins again at Stage I.

key_event: Defected from Bhoomi-Takshaka's Restorationist court three weeks before the new-moon ceremony with the buried-temple blueprints. After the throne-stone falls Gajasena walks to him and the elephant-tattoo appears on his right shoulder-blade. Reads Old Parashurama's bird-letter at chapter's end and accepts the invitation to Kerala.
new_relationships: Bloodline-A cousin to Tungabhadra (deceased) and to her half-sister Krishnaveni of AP; twin brother to Bhoomi-Takshaka (deceased); ward of Hampi-of-the-Bronze and the Third Herald; student-elect of Old Parashurama
notes: New hero of Karnataka. Will be the Maha-Adhipati of Volume I. Yudhishthira-mapped (reluctant king), 36 years old at the moment of the bond transfer.

key_event: No direct Ch 2 prose yet — referenced indirectly in Goa as a distant Bloodline-E cousin who could potentially recover Sagaradeva's lost tridents. Onge-Nakshatra's own Chapter 2 arc TBD in a later session.
notes: Placeholder — awaiting full Ch 2 story for Sagara-Ratna.

key_event: Raised the oldest Konkan cyclone alone in Mormugao Bay using both Samudra and Lahara tridents. Killed Maha-Vega in the storm (cyclone-eye shot at the storm-form's shoulder; throat-shot at the man inside). Lost both tridents into the bay with the body. Held the cyclone empty-handed until the foreign flagship broke on the rocks below Aguada Fort. Released the storm. The release killed him. Body recovered at Sinquerim by Sona Tendulkar.
new_relationships: Bloodline-E uncle to Shivagati (Maharashtra — about to receive the walking gaur-bond); cousin to Simhavikrama (Gujarat) and Mrigatrishna (Rajasthan); distant cousin of Onge-Nakshatra (Andaman) via the same line; the gaur-bond is in transit to Shivagati first then Simhavikrama
notes: Karna-fate fulfilled. He kept the 1873 promise extracted by Bhau Tendulkar's great-grandfather past the point at which it should have been let go. The tridents are lost (53m down in Mormugao Bay). His Stage IV is unearned and unassigned at chapter's end — the mark walks on the gaur herself through the Konkan forest. Per D9 the gaur-bond ends in Ch 3 with Simhavikrama (Gujarat) as the second permanent inheritor of a Bloodline-E double-bond. He is buried alongside Maha-Vega in the same coastal grove by Sona Tendulkar's decision.

key_event: Maintained her Ch 1 federation through the first month of Vanaraksha's primogeniture petition (council count 14-24-9). On day 31 the Goan gaur arrives at her cliff-edge outpost three nights after Sagaradeva's death; the gaur-bond settles as her second bond, hoofprint forms mid-back. Spends a fortnight tour-climbing her remaining forts. On day 49 climbs the eastern wall of Tanaji-the-Second's silent fort alone and unarmed; presents herself in his command-room; he kneels in half-recognition. Squirrel-foreleg completes. Three more forts convert in the following fortnight. Federation count ends 27-20 in her favour. Survives Ch 2 wounded only in trust.
new_relationships: Bloodline-E niece to Sagaradeva (deceased Goa) and cousin to Simhavikrama (Gujarat); elder sister to Vanaraksha; cousin Bhausaheb at Sinhagad is her closest non-Vanaraksha kin; Tanaji-the-Second becomes her first follower-by-skill; partnered (federation) with Ferreira-de-Sangam in Goa via exchanged pigeon-letters
notes: First double-bonded hero in the saga (squirrel + gaur). Abhimanyu-mapped (the brilliant young warrior caught in the chakravyuha she cannot fully exit). Survives Chapter Two with cracks visible — Vanaraksha alive, half her kingdom against her, Maw has taken one of her squirrels. Per restructure §4 she dies in Chapter Three in a duel with Vanaraksha; the squirrel-bond dies with her body, the gaur-bond walks again to Simhavikrama. Her elder cousin Bhausaheb-the-First's grave remains under Vanaraksha's flag at chapter's end — the next-chapter recovery problem.

key_event: Discovered the existence of his 14-year-old son Yamunadatta on day 1 when Radhika of Vrindavan brought the boy to the Lucknow throne-room. Adharma published the elder-bloodline claim from Banaras within 48 hours. Three nights of indecision at the Ganga; Sage Vidyaranya's spirit (cross-kingdom appearance) gave the Krishna-shadow counsel. At the Bara Imambara assembly (~9,000 in attendance) acknowledged the boy and abdicated in his favour in the same speech; placed the Dwadash-Mukut on the boy's head in the half-kneel of dharmic transfer. Mahaguru Drona-of-the-Plain's straight testimony denied Adharma's regency-counter-writ. Stage III foreleg-mark completed at the half-kneel — earned by surrender, not victory.
new_relationships: Bloodline-B half-brother to Adharma (alive in Banaras still drafting writs); now father to Yamunadatta (acknowledged heir of UP); regent-protector under the Imambara settlement; cousin (B+A) to Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata of Karnataka — they exchange pigeon-letters by chapter end; former student of Mahaguru Drona-of-the-Plain (whose 40-year debt to Adharma-Kendra was reversed by his Imambara testimony); ex-lover to Radhika of Vrindavan (now a third-party arbitration-seat dharmic counsellor)
notes: Krishna-mapped (the driver of the chariot, not its rider). The first 'step-back' hero of Chapter 2 — survives, retains the bond, transfers the throne. The barasingha-bond splits into a SPLIT-BOND across two bodies (father at Stage III, son at Stage I) — a saga first, distinct from Maharashtra's double-bond (two animals one body). Per restructure §4 he holds the regent role through Ch 3 and Ch 4; the Stage IV full-body mark he releases to Yamunadatta. Will be the senior North voice at the Sanctuary convening.

key_event: Brought by his mother Radhika from Vrindavan on day 1; named publicly by his father at the throne-room within hours; named again by Adharma at Dasaswamedh Ghat in Banaras 48 hours later. Briefed for ten days by Vidura-Babu in private chamber sessions before the Imambara assembly. Accepted the throne and the regency arrangement in one composed declaration at the Imambara. Sarus Crane landed on his shoulder during the assembly — Stage I hoofprint forms over the following week on his upper back. Survives Ch 2 as the visible Maharaj of UP.
new_relationships: Son of Gangaputra (B) and Radhika (A); half-Bloodline-B / half-Bloodline-A; nephew of Adharma (with whom he has refused political alignment); cousin (and now formally cousin-nephew per Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata's bird-letter) to Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata of Karnataka; will be the boy his uncle Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata meets at the Sanctuary; ward of Vidura-Babu administratively and of his mother Radhika dharmically
notes: Abhimanyu-mapped (the young warrior given more than his years should hold). Fourteen at his coronation. Will grow into the visible throne-figure of the North Dominant in Ch 3 — the senior crown of the Council. Will earn Stages II-III in Ch 3 (Beast-Rising + Unity Trial), Stage IV in Ch 4 (Kurukshetra). His Bloodline-A heritage (through Radhika's Gajavamsha-Vrindavan line) makes him cousin to Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata and to Krishnaveni — the throne-line of Vol I now runs through three Bloodline-A-touched heroes (Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata, Yamunadatta, and the deceased Tungabhadra's lineage).

key_event: Twelve-court system founded in his Ch 1 reign collapses under famine pressure. Adharma-Kendra returns as a 'neutral senior counsellor' weaponising abstain-only voting; courts deadlock for seven weeks while famine deaths climb. Sutrakara (12) presents corrected mortality arithmetic at the assembly; her motion is denied 10-1 with Adharma-Kendra abstaining. Father-daughter corridor conversation reframes dharma as 'what gets done, not what is decided.' Drona-of-the-Plain arrives hunted from Lucknow with proof of villain-coordination across Karnataka, Goa, and MP. Dvadashashringa dissolves all twelve courts by striking the assembly floor 12 times with the Dwadash staff — staff breaks at strike 8, ends in three pieces by strike 12. Stage III foreleg-mark completes CRACKED — visible scar through the antler-curve where bond-ink does not settle. Emergency single-court governance instituted; food convoys move in 48 hours. Final famine death-count: 47,000.
new_relationships: Bloodline-B younger half-brother to Gangaputra (UP — they exchange Sarus Crane letters by chapter end); maternal nephew to Adharma-Kendra (the catalyst); father to Sutrakara (who becomes his official advisor and the future Council non-hero seat); sheltered Drona-of-the-Plain (hunted from UP) as secret guest then public witness; cross-region alliance with Vidura-Babu of UP (two Awadhi administrators arrive on day 3); Aranya-Devi promoted to deputy chief justice
notes: Yudhishthira-mapped (the over-deliberator who must break his own deliberation-system). Survives Chapter Two as Central Dominant. The CRACKED mark is the saga's fifth bond-mechanic — distinct from death-transfer (Karnataka), bond-transit (Goa), double-bond (Maharashtra), and split-bond (UP). Carries the broken Dwadash staff in three pieces wrapped in saffron cloth into every Council session into Ch 3 and Ch 4. His Stage IV mark will form AROUND the crack, not over it. The first hero whose bond records the cost of the choice as a visible scar.

key_event: Discovered her adoptive mother Bhairavi-Naam dead at the Kamakhya temple (cause: cumulative rite-incompletion from secret participation in Kama-Mara's Open Coven). Crossed the Brahmaputra to meet Kama-Mara at the Saraighat ferry — first contact in 14 years. Met the wandering ascetic Bhairavi-Aaee at the temple gate. Lineage reveal: Bhairavi-Aaee is her biological mother AND Kama-Mara's biological mother. The 'cousins' are half-sisters. Authorised the forbidden Mahavidya rite (suppressed for 12 years). Performed the rite with Kama-Mara at the new moon. Earned Stage III rhinoceros-foreleg mark — mirror-position with her sister. The Brahmaputra at Saraighat reversed for one hour during the seventh hour; 114 rhinos at Kaziranga kneeled facing west for the rite's duration. Yielded the political throne to Moirangthem of Manipur. Co-High Priestess with Kama-Mara going forward.
new_relationships: Half-sister to Kama-Mara (same mother Bhairavi-Aaee
inherited_from: different fathers); biological daughter to Bhairavi-Aaee (wandering ascetic); adoptive daughter to the deceased Bhairavi-Naam (matriarch); cousin to Moirangthem of Manipur (Chandravamsha Sangai-deer line — political throne now his); cross-bloodline cousin to Shivagati of Maharashtra (Bloodline C + E intersection); pigeon-letter correspondent with Sutrakara of MP (great-aunt addressed by the 12-year-old)
column14: Bhima + Kali mapped (raw strength of dharma channeled through Tantric Shakti). Survives Chapter Two with the saga's sixth bond-mechanic: the MIRROR-BOND. First sister-bond in Bharatavarsha. Per restructure §1 she becomes the cosmic High Priestess of Kamakhya for Ch 3 and 4 — politically yielding the NE Regional Dominant seat to Moirangthem (Manipur). The Chandravamsha matriarchy continues through her, but the visible political throne is now Manipur. Will hold the cosmic seat at the Sanctuary convening in Ch 3.

key_event: Received Megha-Daitya's 47-petition wave in week 1. Council of Matrilineal Elders fractured three ways (Strict-Matrilineal / Garo-Mixed / Patrilineal Petitioners); she erased herself in council as she had for nine years. Received anonymous warning about Ka-Sngi 4 days before her cousin's death; did not act. Ka-Sngi killed at Nongriat bridge in week 3. U-Mawkynrew arrived in week 4 and broke her silence with one sentence. Drafted and presented the three-part settlement framework at the State Central Library; passed 86-31-4 on day three. Megha-Daitya organised armed storm-faction; attacked Meghalaya High Court at monsoon's heaviest week. Meghanadi charged through the courtyard alone with the Megha-Dand cloud-staff; Stage III foreleg-mark completed at metre 16 of the charge; four submachine-gun shots hit her chest at metre 18; she reached him at metre 22 and drove the staff through his sternum. Mutual kill. Stage III mark complete on her body at death.
new_relationships: Half-cousin to Kamalavarna and Kama-Mara of Assam (Bloodline C — corrected lineage tree); aunt-mother to Ka-Sngi (deceased week 3); aunt to Ka-Sienlyngdoh (12 — future bond-bearer); explicit-wish inheritor U-Khrawkmen (Garo elder's son raised by U-Mawkynrew); cross-kingdom: hill-myna correspondence with Vidura-Babu of UP and Kamalavarna of Assam
inherited_from: Ka-Sienlyngdoh (when bond settles in Ch 3 Beast-Rising)
notes: Kunti-mapped (the mother who carries the silence too long). Second female hero death of Chapter Two (after Tungabhadra). The first hero to earn Stage III IN THE MOMENT OF DYING — the mark completes at metre 16 of the charge, the killing-shots arrive at metre 18, she reaches Megha-Daitya at metre 22. Saga's seventh bond-mechanic: the DORMANT BOND. The clouded leopard stays with the line, waiting for Ka-Sienlyngdoh's threshold. The Megha-Dand cloud-staff is preserved at the State Central Library ceremonial vault. The political seat passes to U-Khrawkmen by explicit written wish (first male inheritor of a matrilineal kingdom in Khasi history).

key_event: Garo-clan elder's son raised by U-Mawkynrew after his parents died in 2018 landslide. Trained as Mixed Council mediator for six years. Quietly co-drafted the settlement framework with U-Mawkynrew over two years preceding the petition wave. Was Meghanadi's protege through the petition months — her second hand on every settlement-clause. Arrived at the Meghalaya High Court courtyard 23 minutes after her death by Pawan Hans helicopter from Tura. Found her sealed letter naming him inheritor; ratified by the Council of Matrilineal Elders within 75 minutes. First male inheritor of a matrilineal kingdom in recorded Khasi history. The clouded-leopard bond did NOT pass to him — it stays with the line for Ka-Sienlyngdoh. He holds the political seat without bond-power.
new_relationships: Great-nephew of U-Mawkynrew (his late mother's aunt); Meghanadi's protege; non-bond co-administrator with Ka-Sienlyngdoh once she carries the bond; federation correspondent with Kamalavarna at Kamakhya (will travel there at new moon) and Moirangthem at Manipur (forthcoming) and Vidura-Babu at UP
notes: Twenty-eight. The saga's first non-bonded political inheritor. His authority is institutional and explicit-wish-based, not bond-based. By Ch 3 he becomes the joint political voice of Meghalaya alongside Ka-Sienlyngdoh (when she carries the bond). By Ch 4 he is a senior council voice in the NE Dominant federation under Moirangthem. Per restructure §4 he is the kingdom's stable institutional presence while the bond is dormant — Meghanadi's invented regent-by-naming mechanism.

key_event: Listened to bazaar-elder Leishemba in week 3 and went to a raw-dance performance at Khwairamband Bazaar; recognised that the classical form had frozen. Tamasa-Nrita returned in month 4 as 'the Father of Raw Dance' and corrupted the genuine artistic rebellion into knife-violence. Accepted a joint-performance invitation at the Loktak central phumdi. Brought his troupe in classical formation. 9 of 12 dancers killed in the 11-minute massacre; 3 survivors plus Moirangthem escaped via the lake. Eight-year-old son Sangaputra had snuck onto the phumdi the night before and witnessed everything from a reed-clump; stayed with the Sangai deer 11 days; brought back the discovery: 'The deer dance and stop. The pause is the dance too.' Moirangthem invented Moirang-Tandava (the pause-school) over the next six days. Public demonstration at Govindaji temple courtyard 18 days after the massacre — Stage III foreleg-mark completed at minute 19 of the performance. Defeated Tamasa-Nrita at the Loktak final duel using the pause-strike technique (19-second held pause beat Tamasa-Nrita's 15-second Lhasa-stillness limit). Exiled Tamasa-Nrita to the Burmese border rather than killing him. Inherited NE political throne by Kamalavarna's formal yielding letter.
new_relationships: Bloodline-C cousin to Kamalavarna at Kamakhya (who has yielded the NE political throne to him); husband to Ka-Memcha (Dzulevira of Nagaland's elder sister) — Manipur-Nagaland marriage-bridge; father to Sangaputra (8 — the pause-discoverer); cross-region correspondent with U-Khrawkmen at Meghalaya (his sister-in-law's kingdom's new inheritor) and with Vidura-Babu at UP; Dzulevira will vote on the NE political throne in Ch 3 if her Nagaland kingdom stabilises
notes: Arjuna-mapped (the trained warrior whose form must be broken open by an unexpected voice — Krishna in the Mahabharata, Sangaputra here). The saga's eighth bond-mechanic: THE FORM-AS-COMBAT-MECHANIC. The pause-strike is the first bond-mechanic that is a combat technique rather than a transmission-mechanism. Per restructure §1 he is the future NE Regional Dominant for Ch 3 — the kingdom's visible political voice, distinct from Kamalavarna's cosmic seat at Kamakhya. His Stage IV mark will be earned at the Sanctuary convening in Ch 3. The new school Moirang-Tandava becomes Manipur's official martial-art-and-dance tradition by chapter end. NOTE: His wife Ka-Memcha is killed in Nagaland's Ch 2 (Tangkhul tribal purity-rite at Ukhrul) — his son Sangaputra is orphaned of mother.

key_event: The Hornbill Festival cancelled in 5.5 hours as all 16 tribes withdraw citing 'ancestral purity-disputes' (each tribe holds a forged DNA-rite kit from Naga-Rakshasa's Chiang Mai forgery operation). Her elder sister Ka-Memcha visits from Imphal to help, is summoned by the Tangkhul Tribal Council to submit to a Pure-Origin Genomic Verification rite as a 'married-out' Tangkhul, refuses publicly at the ceremony grounds at Ukhrul on the 14th day, is pushed into the ceremonial fire by Senior Priest Khrumai-Sho. Dzulevira goes silent two days. Khrieo-Mama (89, Angami matriarch from Khonoma) arrives at midnight day fifteen with the 600-year-old Pre-Tribal Pact (clay tablet, 16 founder thumb-prints) hidden under her floorboards for 41 years. Five days of preparation. The walk: 27 days, 16 valleys, the bull mithun unled beside her, naked-with-ash, reading the Pact in each tribe's dialect, answering all dialect-challenges in Hindi. Pochury confrontation: Naga-Rakshasa appears speaking perfect Pochury, attempts all 16 dialects sequentially against her; she answers in Hindi each time. He retreats east across the Burmese border. Stage III mithun-foreleg mark completes at the moment of his retreat. Returns to Kohima day 28. Defers NE political throne vote to June Hornbill Festival.
new_relationships: Bloodline-C younger sister to the deceased Ka-Memcha (Moirangthem's wife); aunt to the orphaned Sangaputra (8); cousin to Kamalavarna at Kamakhya; sister-in-law to Moirangthem of Manipur (NE political throne yielded to him but her vote deferred to June); Khrieo-Mama becomes her senior advisor; cross-kingdom correspondent through the Sarus-pigeon mesh
notes: Draupadi-mapped (the woman whose refusal at the assembly is the kingdom's dharmic axis). The saga's NINTH bond-mechanic: THE REFUSAL-BOND — bond rewards what is NOT claimed rather than what is taken on. Per restructure §1 she ratifies Moirangthem as NE Regional Dominant in Ch 3 at the rescheduled June Hornbill Festival. Her Stage IV mark will form at that ratification vote. The 27-day walk establishes the saga-rule of the UNCLAIMED LANGUAGE — Hindi for Nagaland; the dance-pause for Manipur; the wall-climb for Maharashtra; the reading-aloud for Karnataka. The kingdom's union spoken back to the kingdom that has fragmented.

key_event: Chakra-Bheda (Kalinga-Yama's Ch 1 senior administrative-disciple, spared 2023) returns spring 2025 in three-tradition syncretic costume (Brahmin-priestly cotton, Shabara-wood-elder anklet, Sadhaba sail-cloth shoulder-cloth) and visits each cult's senior delegate privately across six months with contradictory standing-Fourth-Cult promises. On Wednesday week 3 at noon the three cults declare exclusive right at the Bada Danda simultaneously. Jagannathi runs the standing-investigation weeks 3-5; kingdom-council ratifies the standing-Sixth Clause amendment Friday week 5 (47-3). The standing-Rath-Yatra is cancelled Friday week 6 — first cancellation since 1226 CE (Anangabhima Deva III succession-crisis). The Nandighosha chariot stands abandoned at Singha Dwara for 9 days. The sambar deer leave the kingdom on a single Friday-into-Saturday night (Saturday-week-6 count returns zero across all 4 monitoring zones). Jagannathi files the standing-Rath-Yatra-reopening notice Saturday morning 10:11 a.m. with standing-puller-count of one. Pull begins 4:11 a.m. Saturday week 6. Three cults walk behind the chariot in shared silence at 3-metre-rear from kilometre 1 onward (Shabara ~2,700, Brahmin ~1,200, Sadhaba ~840 by 6:11 a.m. Saturday; growing to ~12,400 by Monday evening). Day-1 reaches 2-km marker at 6:21 p.m. Saturday (vitals elevated-but-sustainable). Day-2 reaches 3-km marker at 4:08 a.m. Sunday (overnight intravenous-saline rest). Mausi Maa Temple stop noon Sunday: Subhadra-of-the-Wood reads the standing-Shabara-anklet evidence aloud at 12:41 p.m.; Chakra-Bheda unmasked; pulled apart by assembled three-cult crowd 12:50-12:54 p.m. (mob-justice under amended-charter Sixth Clause); cremation by Pati-Mahapatra Senapati alone at 3:11 p.m. Day-3 begins 4:11 a.m. Monday after overnight rest; pace ~1 metre per 62 seconds. Collapse at metre 2,703 at 11:43:11 p.m. Monday (vitals at collapse-threshold). Jagannath-Bandhu (her 31-year-old male successor since 2022) joins the pull-rope with the standing-second-shoulder-harness at 11:46 p.m. for the final 800 metres. Standing-arrival-threshold crossed at 11:47:18 p.m. Stage III sambar-deer-foreleg-first-stroke completes at the threshold-crossing moment. Sambar deer return Monday-night-into-Tuesday-morning (Tuesday-week-7 count returns ~14,700). Konark Sun Temple's seven southern-face wheels turn counterclockwise at 1 degree per minute for 13 hours from 12:03 a.m. to 1:03 p.m. Tuesday week 7 (no mechanical mechanism). Amended charter ratified 51-2 nine days post-Yatra.
new_relationships: Bloodline-D sambar-deer-line; cross-kingdom Sarus-pigeon correspondent with Moirangthem at Manipur (NE-Federation cross-region observation cohort) and Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata at Karnataka (southern-bloc cross-region acknowledgement); cross-region paired-sign correspondent with Kamalavarna at Assam (Konark counterclockwise wheels paired with Brahmaputra reversal as saga's 4th cross-region Maw-sign pair); successor Jagannath-Bandhu (31; East-Dominant successor; inherits Ch 3 after her early-Ch 3 sacrificial death)
notes: Bhima-mapped (the builder who became the puller). The saga's EIGHTEENTH bond-mechanic: the SOLITARY-PULL BOND — Stage III earned by performing the kingdom-council's standing-ritual-task alone when standing-multi-faction-coordination has deadlocked, with the standing-charter not specifying a minimum-puller-count and the standing-partner-permission clause permitting a single standing-partner to join at the final-arrival-threshold if the hero collapses within the final-800-metres window. Per restructure §4 Jagannathi dies in early Chapter Three pulling the chariot again through a Maw-attack during the first Beast-Rising; the deity-trial absorbs her; Jagannath-Bandhu inherits the East Dominant. Per restructure §1 he is the new East Dominant in Ch 3. The standing-amended Kalinga-Chakra charter (6 core provisions: three-cult rotation-codification; Rath-Yatra puller-count threshold; Sixth Clause religious-tradition-impersonation criminalisation; standing-living-archive seat for Subhadra-of-the-Wood; engineer-priestess dual-discipline opened to non-Brahmin; East-Dominant-successor seat for Jagannath-Bandhu) is ratified 51-2 nine days post-Yatra. The kingdom-council's standing-Animal-Bond-Indicator (sambar deer departure-and-return) is codified as the standing-second-order Maw-sign-cross-reference protocol.

key_event: Chitrabheda activates standing-reflective-residence protocol at 8:43 a.m. on chapter's opening Tuesday — ~3,000 simultaneous installations across Hyderabad reflective surfaces that crossed the 14-month minimum-daily-presence threshold. Chittaranga's elder brother Lalithanga (35; standing Cyber-Hyderabad cell-administrator at Gachibowli west-tower) is among them. Chittaranga's grey eye reads the standing-double-reflection at his eastern-courtyard window at 9:11 a.m. that Tuesday. Visits Lalithanga at the HITEC City office at 10:30 a.m.; brothers establish the standing Wednesday breakfast monitoring-protocol. Overlay progresses across weeks 3-6 (day 23 to day 44 / 50%). Tuesday week six at 11:18 p.m. Lalithanga grants standing-killing-permission via secure-line telephone. Wednesday week six 3:10:11 a.m. at the Golkonda Fort mirror-vault basement Hall of Diamonds: Lalithanga speaks the brother-words at 3:08 ('I am still here. Wait.'); Chittaranga throws the Ranga (shadow-dark Truth) disc at standing-killing-velocity over six metres; disc passes through brother's chest at 3:10:11:3 and embeds in southern-wall mirror-fragment; mirror shatters; standing-residence-anchor destroyed; overlay-link severed; body falls at 3:10:11:8; standing-cerebral-spinal axis stops at 3:10:12. Cremation Wednesday 3 p.m.; ashes scattered at Musi-river-mouth 5:11 p.m. Three nights without sleep. Standing-mirror-monitoring registry built across weeks 6-11 (7,417 confirmed Chitrabheda-resident citizens). Standing-Cantonment medical-cell's standing-disruption protocols administered by week-of-overlay classification. Mecca Masjid courtyard Friday week eleven 11 a.m.: ~14,000 attendees; Imam Hazrat Mohammed-Ali Qadri opens with standing-pre-prayer-public-assembly statement; Chittaranga walks to standing-central-position 50 metres from the standing-subject Krishna-Bhat (26; standing reflective-grid sub-administrator; 51% Chitrabheda-saturation, week-9 overlay-position per the standing-registry's Thursday week 10 6 p.m. classification CH-2026-7,394); Chittaranga recites the standing-seven-sentences-form open-trust declaration across 30 minutes. Stage III spotted-deer-foreleg-first-stroke completes at 11:30 a.m. at standing-seventh-sentence's completion. Charminar's five-shadow Maw-sign at 12 noon for 13 minutes — the fifth shadow is Lakshmi-Akka's standing-twelve-noon-prayer dancer-pose.
new_relationships: Bloodline-D spotted-deer-line; cross-region Sarus-pigeon correspondent with Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata at Karnataka (southern-bloc Dominant) and Kurinjiselvi at TN (standing-elder); cross-kingdom paired-sign correspondent with Udayagiri at Arunachal (Charminar five-shadows paired with First Herald shadow-deficit as saga's third cross-region Maw-sign pair); standing-Sufi-line correspondent with Bhagmati-Saheba and Imam Hazrat Mohammed-Ali Qadri; standing-Cantonment correspondent with Padmavathi-garu (standing-archive senior-officer); the kingdom-council's standing-mirror-monitoring registry's standing-state-hero seat-holder
notes: Arjuna-shadow-mapped (the perception-disciplined warrior who must learn to suspend the discipline). The saga's SEVENTEENTH bond-mechanic: the OPEN-TRUST BOND — Stage III earned by publicly declaring open trust in a stranger whom the standing-perception-discipline could pre-check but which the kingdom-council's amended-charter explicitly forbids pre-checking. Distinct from AP's mercy-bond (which rejects an action) in that the open-trust bond performs an action (declaring trust). The bond grows through risk, not certainty. Chittaranga is the saga's first hero forced to perform a family-killing under the standing-charter (his elder brother Lalithanga; the killing cannot be un-killed). The standing-grief-vigil's standing-eight-night-cycle plus standing-eight-additional-night cycle with the standing-Sufi-line elder Bhagmati-Saheba carrying the deceased mother Lakshmi-Akka's standing-cadence-prayer is the kingdom-council's standing-charter-required-form for the family-killing aftermath. The mother died 2008-12-12; the standing-cadence-prayer was composed by her in 1987 at the Charminar Sufi dargah northern-courtyard women's circle; Bhagmati-Saheba is the standing-vessel-of-voice across 1987-2026. The Charminar's fifth shadow at noon Friday week eleven is the kingdom-council's standing-Maw-recognised standing-mother-presence at the standing-courtyard. Per restructure §1 Telangana joins the southern-bloc federation under Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata's Karnataka Dominant seat in Ch 3.

key_event: Palinisi (Ravana-Vadham's Ch 1 senior administrative-disciple, spared under standing-administrative-rehabilitation clause; rose to Sangam Hall authorisation-clerk seat by spring 2025) weaponises the standing 48-hour pre-clearance window through 'clarification-queries.' Across 18 months and 93 council sessions, 147 Sangam-poets silenced under the standing thirty-second clause's rotation-and-refreshment provision. Acharya Bharati (83; Sage Agastya's 11th-direct-apprentice; Kurinjiselvi's mentor; chair of the standing-poetry sub-committee 1997-2026) struck from rota on chapter's opening Monday 1 February at 4:03 a.m. Writes the 43-minute leaf-letter to Kurinjiselvi the same morning; releases parakeet-courier Pavalam westward at 5:14 a.m. Dies at 5:48 a.m. on Thursday 4 February at Kanyakumari residence's kitchen-table; cause 'natural causes; cardiac arrhythmia.' Kurinjiselvi walks down from the Nilgiris Tuesday 2 February at 4 a.m.; 14-day mountain-trail walk; arrives Madurai Meenakshi temple-city Friday 15 February at 10:23 a.m.; Sangam Hall northern entrance at 10:47. Palinisi at authorisation-clerk desk reads the standing-handbook's standard-secondary-response statement at 10:59-11:01:43; the statement crosses the 11:00 session-start threshold by 1 minute 43 seconds and is procedurally invalid. At 11:01:43 the standing-poetry sub-committee acting-chair Iyer-Periya performs the standing-acknowledgement gesture (palms together at the chest) — the gesture not performed in the Sangam Hall in 3 centuries. Kurinjiselvi walks the 3 metres to the central speaker's-mark stone; plants the Kurinji-staff at her right side; speaks the 11 syllables of the Acharya Bharati's 1989 Thirukkural-couplet opening phrase ('Vaay-pakka adai-ppoo varum-mun moli-yaa nukkindra varai') across 5.3 seconds. Stage III Nilgiri-tahr-foreleg-first-stroke appears across her left side at the 11th syllable's completion at 11:02:18 a.m. (the same moment Palinisi begins the standard-secondary-response; Palinisi stops at the third sentence). She continues the full 107-syllable composition across 11 minutes. Iyer-Periya announces the kingdom-council's emergency-session at 11:02:33. The 12-day emergency-session drafts the amended Sangam-charter (7 provisions; authorisation-clerk office dissolved; open-registration replaces pre-clearance; standing living-archive seat instituted; Palinisi reassigned to Sangam-archives wing junior-archivist seat). Ratified 38-4 on day 12 at 3:37 p.m. Kurinji flowers bloom a year early at Nilgiri Mountains' southern slope on day 12 night. Post-amendment open-assembly evening day 62 (7 p.m. - 4:11 a.m.): Avvaiyar-the-Younger recites 147 silenced poems across 6 hours and 3 minutes; Tholkappiyan-the-Younger introduced as standing succession-candidate; Kurinjiselvi formally steps back to standing-elder seat at 3:18 a.m.
new_relationships: Bloodline-D Nilgiri-tahr-line; cross-kingdom Sarus-pigeon correspondent with Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata at Karnataka (southern-bloc federation member) and Sivakami-Acharyini at Kerala (cross-kingdom kalari-tradition pairing); cross-region paired-sign correspondent with Hmangaihi at Mizoram (TN epic-page paired with Mizoram two-headed serow as the saga's second formally-recognised cross-region Maw-sign pair); cross-archive correspondent with Avvaiyar-the-Younger (standing living-archive seat-holder) and Tholkappiyan-the-Younger (standing visible-seat-holder) for the federation's Sanctuary representation
notes: Draupadi-mapped. The saga's SIXTEENTH bond-mechanic: the UNAUTHORISED-SPEECH BOND — Stage III earned by speaking publicly in a council chamber before the authorisation-protocol has completed its standing-procedural-response, with the speech itself being the kingdom-council's standing-protocol's required-form (the Acharya Bharati's 1989 Thirukkural-couplet drawn from the kingdom-council's standing-archive). Per restructure §4 she steps back to standing-elder seat at Ch 2 close; Stage IV substituted by standing-elder seat investiture (the deep-saffron shoulder-cloth placed by senior-mentor seat-rota chair Manimekalai-Periya at 3:18 a.m. on the day-62 open-assembly evening). Per Ch 3 plan she travels to the Sanctuary at Manipur as standing-elder representative; per Ch 4 plan she serves as the southern federation's standing standing-elder voice at the Kurukshetra Council. Kurinji-staff returns to the Nilgiri Mountains standing-stand on 22 February; the blade is dulled by trail-friction and not re-sharpened. The kingdom-council's amended Sangam-charter is the first kingdom-council charter-amendment of the chapter to institute a standing-mentor seat-rota-administered open-registration replacing a single-clerk pre-clearance; the precedent applies to all subsequent kingdoms with authorisation-protocol weaponisation.

key_event: Kalaniksha (Krishnaveni's spared twin from Ch 1, raised by the Eluru-line midwife-extension family, organising the river-bound delta peasant-fishermen for 2 years post-Narakasura) walks north across the Prakasham Barrage Bridge at 8:47 a.m. on the chapter's opening Tuesday with 300 fishermen behind her, files an emergency-petition at Town Hall at 9:26 claiming the river-throne by birth-order with a 47-page family-archive document from the Eluru District Sub-Registrar's Office dated 16 June 1990. Krishnaveni accepts the contest of arms by sunset. The 47-day preparation-window opens. Pulakeshi-Babu (43, kingdom's senior Bloodline-A historian, Authenticity Cell chair) opens his maternal grandfather's safe in Vijayawada Old Town on the afternoon of week 4 and discovers the same 47-page family-archive document plus a 1992 supplementary affidavit; recognises himself within 11 minutes of reading the cover-memorandum as Krishnaveni's first cousin (his father was Lakshmi Babu's elder brother; Lakshmi Babu was Krishnaveni's mother; the twins are his first cousins). Discloses personal-conflict to Authenticity Cell deputy C. Ravi-Babu at 8:06 p.m. same evening; recuses himself from the cell's preliminary report. Discloses the 1992 supplementary affidavit's fourth matter (Kalaniksha's intersex-birth status; the female gender-presentation was a family-decision; kingdom's post-1998 protocol does not apply retroactively) to Krishnaveni at the state hero's residence evening-tea room at 9:11 p.m. The 47-day preparation: morning urumi-practice at the Krishna riverbank at 5 a.m.; afternoon balance-practice at the Kollur cliff's western approach at 3 p.m.; evening dharma-counsel with Acharya Sundaram (Rishi Amareshwara's appointed successor; 48-year-old river-sage); night-time meditation at the residence's eastern-garden river-pavilion. Krishnaveni concentrates the preparation on the Godavari-urumi (left-arm)'s disarming-discipline; she does not adjust the Krishna-urumi (right-arm)'s grip-tension for contest-tension; this is the chapter's structural pivot. The contest at the Kollur cliff at dawn on day 47: Kalaniksha invokes the kingdom-council's under-armament-by-twin-choice clause at 5:56 a.m. and fights left-handed with a single delta-fisherwoman's urumi; the contest begins at 6:11 a.m. when first-light reaches the plateau's eastern edge. Stroke 6 at 6:17:23: Kalaniksha disarms Krishnaveni's Krishna-urumi via the one-handed disarm-rotation; the loose grip-tension makes the technique work. Stroke 11 at 6:24:11: Kalaniksha disarms the Godavari-urumi via the dual-urumi forced-disarmament cross-attack. Krishnaveni stands disarmed at the plateau's centre. At 6:25:02 a.m. Kalaniksha's ceremonial flourish enters the killing-stroke arc; the Krishna-urumi's blade passes Krishnaveni's throat at 4 centimetres' distance without contact. Kalaniksha holds the stroke. She returns the Godavari-urumi to Krishnaveni at 6:25:14. Stage III blackbuck-foreleg-first-stroke forms on Krishnaveni's half-body tattoo's left foreleg at 6:25:30 a.m., 28 seconds after Kalaniksha's departing bow. Exile across the Tirupati border by sunset of day 49. Hamsaladeevi village's eastern beach loses 1 metre of land overnight (day 48). Autumn coastal-protection-protocol drafted across 4 months under Pulakeshi-Babu's liaison seat; ratified 23-1 at the autumn kingdom-council.
new_relationships: Bloodline-A river-line; cross-region Sarus-pigeon correspondent with Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata (Karnataka — established cousin-claim via the 1990 family-archive document; cross-region acknowledgement-letter at day 27 of the preparation-period; autumn Hamsaladeevi visit confirmed for the coastal-protection-protocol drafting); cross-kingdom kalari-tradition correspondent with Sivakami-Acharyini (Kerala — the southern-bloc federation's kalari root); brother to Bhimavaram (river-patrol senior delegate; Acting Daily-Administrative Chair across the preparation-period); first-cousin to Pulakeshi-Babu (kingdom's Bloodline-A liaison-and-historian
inherited_from: Authenticity Cell chair recused); the kingdom's standing guru Acharya Sundaram (the 48-year-old river-sage who succeeded Rishi Amareshwara in 2024)
column14: Draupadi-mapped. The saga's FIFTEENTH bond-mechanic: the MERCY-BOND — Stage III earned by repeating Ch 1's charter-flaw mercy at a Ch 2 institutional-pressure moment where the kingdom-council's charter forbids the killing but the personal-emotional-pressure permits it. Distinct from the Karnataka rule's Heralds-are-named-not-killed (which applies to Heralds); the mercy-bond applies to hero-twin and hero-cousin and hero-sibling and hero-rival catalyst-villains. The first formal twin-knot in the saga's registry (the Chandravamsha three-sister-knot at Kamakhya was a sister-knot; the AP pair is a true twin-pair born 23 minutes apart). The first material-experiment Maw-sign cross-region pair recognised by the southern federation (Kerala's black coconut + AP's erased metre); the pairing-protocol becomes the saga's standing catalogue-pattern-recognition method. Per restructure §4 she dies in early Chapter Three in the twin-confrontation's final phase; the river-bond transfers via Bloodline-A to Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata (her cousin), making him the second hero in Volume I with a double-bond after Simhavikrama (lion + gaur); Pulakeshi-Babu kills Kalaniksha afterwards. Half-armed at chapter end (Godavari at her left forearm; Krishna in Kalaniksha's possession at the Tirupati exile-camp).

key_event: Kala-Hasta Menon (Maya-Sura's Ch 1 star pupil; survived the Ch 1 climax confrontation; trained at the Kollam Coiled-Cobra cell with urumi-and-cobra-venom training intact; spent 2017-2024 in the Bangalore-and-Gulf kalari-diaspora teaching the 108 forms while privately practising the 109th) registers the Sea-Front Kalari at the Kerala state-government's religious-and-cultural-practice registry on 23 March under the standard kalari-charter; the registry's 30-day public-comment window produces no objection; registration approved 22 April. Inaugural class opens at the Kochi waterfront amphitheatre Monday 8 April with 423 paying students at Rs.4,000/month, phased instruction across 7 phases over 24 weeks. Parashurama reads the advertisement in Malayala Manorama at 5:48 a.m. on the chapter's opening Tuesday. Achyutan-the-Nephew (37, Parashurama's elder sister's son, Bloodline-A, senior daily-teaching deputy, mastered all 108 forms by 33) defects to the Sea-Front Kalari Friday of week 2 with mother's written consent. Compresses the public school's 24-week phasing into a 3-week private-practice schedule. Dies at the public class's seventh-transition demonstration Sunday of week 3 at 5:58 a.m. (basilar artery vascular rupture during central rotation; phasing-violation cited on death-certificate; cross-confirmed Kochi Medical College). Cremation at the kalari's western grove at sunset same day; mother Lakshmi-Akka lights the fire 7:02 p.m.; Kala-Hasta attends at the grove's western edge; Parashurama sits at the eastern edge until 11 p.m. with his sister. Kingdom-council emergency amended Kerala-Kalari Charter drafted across 3 days, ratified 23-0 with Parashurama's abstention on day 31 evening. Sivakami-Acharyini (29, Parashurama's elder brother's daughter) conferred the 108-form grandmaster-title at the kalari's evening ceremony day 23 (kingdom's first female 108-form grandmaster ceremony in recorded history). Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata arrives 17 April at 3:47 p.m. via the bird-letter sent at the Karnataka pilot's closing day. 31-day transmission begins evening day 1; Parashurama ages forward visibly across the 31 days (white hair by week 1, full white-and-beard by week 3, rounded shoulders by week 4, age ~74 by day 31). Chamber unsealed day 30 at 2 p.m. by Parashurama speaking the ancient-Malayalam 47-syllable sealing-mantra. Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata executes the form alone in the chamber at 6:01-6:44 a.m. day 31. Stage III stroke completes on the elephant-tattoo's right foreleg the moment of execution-completion at 6:44 a.m. Chamber re-sealed at 6:45 a.m. with the new Kannada-Malayalam interlinear 73-syllable mantra. Black coconut sign at the western grove discovered 6 a.m. day 32.
new_relationships: Bloodline-D elephant-and-axe-line; cross-kingdom Sarus-pigeon correspondent network alerted at chapter-end by Sivakami's cascade-alert; cross-region acknowledgement-and-naming-protocol established with Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata (Karnataka) for the autumn joint-naming of the black coconut; cross-school institutional acknowledgement with Kala-Hasta Menon (Sea-Front Kalari) under the amended Kerala-Kalari Charter; transferred the 108-form daily-teaching seat to Sivakami-Acharyini at the day-23 grandmaster ceremony; transmitted the 109th form to Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata as the saga's first transmission-bond inheritance
notes: Karna-mapped-then-Vyasa-mapped. The saga's FOURTEENTH bond-mechanic: the TRANSMISSION-BOND — Stage III earned by faithful transmission of a sealed inheritance to a single chosen student, with the senior master paying the time-cost in real-time forward-aging across the transmission-period. Distinct from inheritance-by-bond-transfer (Karnataka pilot's elephant-bond transfer at Tungabhadra's death) in that the transmission-bond is teaching, not death; the senior master survives. The saga's first split-Stage-III: the mark is on Parashurama's body (right foreleg of the elephant-tattoo) and the form is in Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata's spine, the two bound by the transmission-bond as a paired mark across two heroes. The saga's first ages-forward-by-15-years bond-cost. Per restructure §1 Kerala joins the NE-South-Federation under Krishnadevaraya-Bhrata's Karnataka Dominant seat in Ch 3 as the federation's kalari-tradition root; three senior daily-teaching instructors from Sivakami's kalari will travel to Vijayanagara in the autumn at the buried-temple chamber's eastern annex. Parashurama will attend the Sanctuary as Kerala's formal representative; will not perform any form at the Sanctuary; will sit at the southern observer's bench; the kingdom hears his voice in writing only from day 31 forward. The axe Parashu is at the wall-stand at the senior-instructor's residence; he picks it up once a quarter for the seasonal-purification ritual; he will not engage in combat in Volume I.

key_event: Tripura-Asura's senior strategist Tri-Yantra-Bheda (rakshasa-engineer with forged Singapore civil-engineering-vulnerability doctorate; one of 14 forged senior-technical-credentials the wider villain-network has produced) had been studying Tripurari's self-repair-architecture publications since 2018. Apurba Saha (Border-Trade Consortium chair) provided the Sub-Pump-Three anomalous-readings, the Old-Kamala-Sagar emergency-reserve protocol, and the Lake Rudrasagar parallel-test schedule to a Bangladesh-side intermediary at the noon-break of the June water-rights committee meeting; information in Tripura-Asura's flying-fortress operations-cell by sundown. Triple sabotage executed at 9 p.m. on the second-monsoon-week Saturday of week 6 by injecting reverse-stress signal through the kingdom's own pressure-monitoring sensor-network at three insertion-points (Agartala Sub-Pump-Three, Udaipur central-market cistern, Dharmanagar rubber-warehouse industrial intake). Self-repair algorithms operated in reverse. Three central districts collapsed in 17-minute sequence: 9:03 Agartala Ujjayanta administrative-block; 9:09 Udaipur central-market jute-godowns + temple outer-courtyard wall; 9:14 Dharmanagar rubber-warehouse + Border-Trade office + Refugee-Resettlement office; 9:20 Agartala Bharat-Yantra institute east wing. Tripurari at the engineering-research-cell weekly review at 9:03 collapse; buried at 7-metre depth in a pocket-space formed by a 43-degree fallen support-beam. The 18th Phayre's Langur (mature male, ~12 years, 9 kg) entered the pocket-space between days 3 and 5 through a southeast gap; died on day 8 of dehydration after Tripurari gave it his remaining water 47 minutes earlier. Tripurari pulled out at 4:11 p.m. on day 9 alive but with the entire palace-grove Phayre's Langur clan (17 + the 18th visiting member) dead in the central-Agartala rubble. Bond is broken; bond requires the clan; the clan is gone. Did not speak for 6 days at the field-hospital. On day 15 named Vyasa-of-the-Margins aloud; Margin-walker arrived at the field-hospital at 3 a.m. day 21 unannounced (passed 3 security checkpoints without being stopped). Formal abdication at the Agartala southern-edge open-air kingdom-council session at noon day 23, ratified 21-3. Walked west from the Ujjayanta Palace western gate at 5 a.m. day 24 in undyed cotton with the Triyantra crossbow disassembled into 3 parts in a leather satchel. Arrived at the Margin-hermitage day 43. Stopped walking day 44. Now the Margins' standing engineer-apprentice.
new_relationships: Bloodline-D Phayre's Langur-line (now broken); cross-kingdom Sarus-pigeon correspondent only via the Margin-hermitage's full-moon-and-new-moon-pair correspondence with Triputra (every fortnight; archived at the Bhubaneswari Temple manuscript-vault under Anjali Debbarma's seal); will reappear in Ch 3 as cross-kingdom standing voice on broken-bond integration; will be named formally a Margin-guru at the Ch 4 Kurukshetra Council (his fortieth year)
notes: Karna-shadow / Margin-guru-in-waiting. The saga's HERO FALL of Chapter Two — distinct from the saga's HERO DEATHS (Tungabhadra/Karnataka, Sagaradeva/Goa, Meghanadi/Meghalaya, Tlangvala/Mizoram). The saga's THIRTEENTH bond-mechanic: the BROKEN-BOND — the bond's formal cessation when the bonded species' local lineage is extinguished beyond the bond's recovery-threshold. The bond cannot be re-bonded in Volume I (the surviving statewide Phayre's Langur population of ~340 is geographically discontinuous with the palace-grove). Tattoo-3 FAILED; Stage III mark cannot form because the clan was the trial-witness. Tripurari's formal renunciation of the bond is the saga's first entry in the broken-bond registry maintained at the Margin-hermitage. The Triyantra crossbow is disassembled and carried to the hermitage; will be displayed once a year at the autumn engineering-festival but never fired again. Per restructure §1 Tripura joins NE Federation under Moirangthem in Ch 3 as the federation's smallest and most fragile member; the three cities rebuild under separate cross-kingdom mutual-aid compacts (Agartala under Bilash-Babu's West Bengal structural-engineering compact; Udaipur under Kamalavarna's Kamakhya-Bhubaneswari religious-administration compact; Dharmanagar under Hmangaihi-and-Lalruatpuia's Aizawl-Dharmanagar refugee-resettlement compact). The saga has space for broken-bond heroes; their function is to carry institutional engineering, poetry, philosophy into the federation's administration as Margin-counsel. Thirty-four. Now Margin-apprentice; will be Margin-guru at age forty.

key_event: Parvata-Asura (Chhinlung-Naag's mountain-form, now standalone after his Ch 1 retreat) returns spring 2025 and visits all 8 Mizoram district-headquarters across summer 2026 offering 'refuge from the inheritance' inside Phawngpui Mountain to 15-22 year olds. 629 Mizos accept and enter the eastern-face fissure at the new-moon week of week 4. The fissure closes at dawn. The asura demands one perfect sacrifice. Refusing Youth Manifesto (drafted spring 2025 by Tlangvala's 22-year-old son Lalruatpuia, published August 2026 at the Aizawl Synod hall biennial Youth Council to 4-minute applause from 1,400 Refusing Youth; December 2025 sit-in had hardened the senior tribal-elders' position by 20 per cent) is the chapter's long-correctness backdrop. Kingdom-council deliberates 7 days; votes 20-2 to deliver Tlangvala (option 4); then takes unprecedented second vote 15-7 to formally request that he not return. Tlangvala accepts both votes. Single father-son reconciliation conversation at his Aizawl home on Sunday evening before the Tuesday entry. Walks alone to the eastern granite face at 5:31 a.m. on day 3 of week 11 carrying the bamboo staff-spear Hnam-Tuk and dressed in his son's Manifesto-style plain Mizo wool. The fissure opens at first-light; he steps through; the granite closes 12 seconds after his entry. Across the next 43 minutes the Stage III serow-foreleg mark forms on the eastern granite face as a 47-metre living-rock relief, structurally integrated into the granite's recomposed mineral state, visible from 23 km. The southern fissure opens at 6:32 a.m.; the 629 locked youth emerge across 11 minutes; none die inside. Parvata-Asura partially dissolves; survives in depleted form into the Chin-state border-zone. The wild serow walks down to Hmangaihi at 7:53 a.m. The kingdom-council ratifies the reformed three-clause Manifesto by 18-6 vote on the Friday following the funeral; Lalruatpuia and Hmangaihi cast the joint-signature; Ramdinmawia resigns the senior chair; Lalrinpuii of the Synod succeeds.
new_relationships: Bloodline-D serow-line; cross-kingdom Sarus-pigeon correspondent network alerted at chapter-end by Hmangaihi's cascade-alert; left the bamboo staff-spear Hnam-Tuk to his son Lalruatpuia (passed at the funeral procession by Ramdinmawia's spoken declaration); left the serow-bond to his niece Hmangaihi (passed at the western trailhead when the wild serow walked down from Phawngpui's southern ridge)
inherited_from: Hmangaihi (Stage I on her body) + the mountain (Stage III on its eastern face permanently)
notes: Karna-mapped (the man who could not refuse, exploited by the kingdom's culture, who finally chose the form of the refusal that meant his death). Saga's FOURTH HERO DEATH in Chapter Two (after Tungabhadra in Karnataka, Sagaradeva in Goa, Meghanadi in Meghalaya). The saga's TWELFTH bond-mechanic: the MOUNTAIN-MARK — the first hero-death bond-mark to be carried by the landscape rather than by the hero's body or by a successor's body. Visible from 23 km; permanent for at least 800 years per geological assessment; the saga's first landscape-borne Stage III mark. Distinct from previous split-marks: UP's split-bond split one animal across two bodies; Assam's mirror-bond mirrored one mark across two sisters; Mizoram's mountain-mark splits one mark across the landscape and the successor's body simultaneously. The bier-bamboo (6 m, bent to 35 degrees, cut by Hmangaihi and Lalruatpuia together the night before the funeral) sits at the base of the mark as the kingdom's permanent memorial. Tended by Vanlalruati who refreshes the bend with a small saffron cord each morning. By chapter end ~52,000 Mizos (~30% of the adult population) have visited.

key_event: The Tawang night-cult grows to 1,100 members in 14 months, drawing from Galwan-2020 veterans, Tawang-clash-2022 bereaved, and Ziro-fire-2024 burned survivors. Asta-Asura the shadow-twin returns as the Comforter at the Sela-Pass shadow-zone listening-floor. Udayagiri meets him at week 2 and asks the three questions (Are you Asta-Asura. Are you here to destroy the dawn-walk. What would you ask of the kingdom.). Climbs to the cloud-line at week 3 to consult Baba Parashar; the cloud-speaker articulates the curve as the kingdom's required answer and announces he will descend the next day. At the Tawang valley pass on day 3 of week 3, Baba Parashar is killed by two arrows/bullets fired without coordination by a 23-year-old dawn-walker and a 31-year-old night-cultist. Udayagiri spends 8 days above the cloud-line and returns with the architectural plans for the first Dawn-Shadow Temple. Eleven-week build-out at Tawang with 300 workers in mixed-faction pairs by Tani-of-the-Veil's rota. Consecrated week 11 at first-light (5:43 a.m.). Stage III gayal-foreleg mark completes 14 seconds after Tani lifts her veil and the kingdom sees the eye-socket the 2022 clash took. The First Herald walks through Roing at 6:57 a.m. the same morning; named Sahodara-Aapun by 13-year-old Yapum-Mihu three weeks later. Three Temples in active construction at chapter end: Tawang consecrated, Roing (Herald-return room) foundations laid, Lower Subansiri foundations laid.
new_relationships: Bloodline-D sun-line dawn-walker; cross-kingdom Sarus-pigeon correspondent with Moirangthem (NE Dominant candidate; vote committed) and Kanchenjunga (Sikkim; concession-bond complements the boundary-bond; mutual-records exchange between Sonam-Lama-Bumla and Lobsang established within 30 days); ratified by 5-kingdom NE-Federation registry on day 23; appointed Tani-of-the-Veil as Temple translator and Asta-Asura as shade-master
notes: Yudhishthira-mapped (the reluctant inheritor of a kingdom-restructuring decision he cannot articulate before the mentor articulates it). The saga's ELEVENTH bond-mechanic: the CONCESSION-BOND — bond rewards publicly conceding ground to a grievance the kingdom's historic virtue has failed to address. Distinct from Sikkim's boundary-bond in that the boundary-bond draws a new exclusion while the concession-bond draws a new inclusion. The two are complementary: Kanchenjunga closes the Charter against a single named violation; Udayagiri opens the Charter to a single named architecture. Per restructure §1 he joins the NE Federation under Moirangthem in Ch 3 after the First Herald has been named. The Order of the Dawn-Shadow Temple becomes the saga's template for virtue-restructuring institutional answers (replicated at Roing and Lower Subansiri within the chapter; will replicate at Goa Karwar in Volume Two, at Yavana-Khanda coastal sites in Volume Two-Three). Thirty-one. Two thousand seven hundred and forty-eight consecutive dawn-greetings before the chapter; one skipped (week 3 day 3 morning while climbing back down from the cloud-line); resumed on the next dawn. The daily re-forging of the Uday-spear unbroken across the chapter.

key_event: The Chintamani stolen from the Rumtek inner sanctum at the autumn Refugee-Blessing Ceremony — extracted by Krodha (under the forged identity 'Krodha-Sherpa of Pelliang Village') during the standard 15-minute seating-rotation interval at 1:47 p.m., hidden in the upper chamber of the dawn-prayer-wheel beside barrack 17-C at the south refugee camp. Forty-seven days of silent search by Lobsang and Sonam under Kanchenjunga's strict-confidentiality discipline. On dawn of day 47 a 16-year-old Tibetan refugee girl named Pema-Chöden walks to the monastery east gate and identifies the Refugee Father as Krodha (recognised from her own coloured-pencil drawing of his face done at age 8 in Pelliang Village 2018 at her mother's instruction). Kanchenjunga walks the 4 km to the south camp at noon with the Karmapa-line walking-staff and the deputy chief-secretary. Delivers the 7-minute boundary-speech naming Krodha, the theft, the sub-council, and the exile. Approximately 700 refugees stay; 600 leave with Krodha across the Lachen pass over three days. Pema-Chöden retrieves the Chintamani from the dawn-prayer-wheel's upper chamber at 1:06 p.m. using the recovered Karmapa-line key. Stage III red-panda-foreleg mark completes on his right pectoral at 1:08 p.m. — 11 seconds after she straightens at his left shoulder with the jewel against her chest.
